display.purpose: Fraunces serif for h1-h6, card titles, section headers.

body.purpose: Manrope sans for paragraphs and default copy.

label.purpose: Manrope bold/uppercase for buttons, badges, nav items.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Teal ambient glow for emphasis moments.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single gold call-to-action per screen — approve, pay, ship.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.68rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.82rem; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; background: #f6a313; color: #003746; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(246, 163, 19, 0.22); transition: 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #df8d00; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 95, 115, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #003746; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.68rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.82rem; border: 1px solid #dfe5da; cursor: pointer; background: #ffffff; color: #52666b; transition: 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f6f2; border-color: #8a9a9e; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #003746; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content container — flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Parcel #RB-00214

Received today from Amazon.in — awaiting inspection.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fbfbf8; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #eaeee7; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.025); } .ds-card-header { padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #eaeee7; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #132326; margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1rem 1.1rem; color: #132326; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic pill marking parcel/shipment lifecycle state.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-status-approved { background: #ECFDF5; color: #059669; } .ds-status-pending { background: #e8f4f3; color: #003746; } .ds-status-action { background: #FEF2F2; color: #DC2626; } .ds-status-returned { background: #FFFBEB; color: #B45309; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Text input with teal focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; border: 2px solid #eaeee7; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; background: #f5f6f2; transition: 0.2s; color: #132326; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #003746; background: #ffffff; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #e8f4f3; }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation link, default and active/seal state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.62rem 0.72rem; color: rgba(245, 251, 249, 0.86); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.78rem; margin-bottom: 0.22rem; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); background: #0d2b3c; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #fff8e8; transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffb82e, #f3a10f); color: #003746; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(246, 163, 19, 0.22); }

narrative.overview:
CamelTrunk's interface reads as an official expedition ledger: a deep teal-and-navy operator's book with gold seals marking the things that matter. The dominant surfaces are near-black teal (#003746 "Caravan Teal") and a deeper ink (#123844 "Blackberry Ink"), with a warm treasure-gold (#f6a313) reserved for accents, active states, and calls to action — the wax-seal moment against an otherwise disciplined, procedural canvas. Cream-white surfaces (#fbfbf8–#eaeee7) and generous rounding (8–24px) keep the ledger from feeling cold or bureaucratic; this is a serious operator handling your parcels and money, but not a sterile one.

The system is dashboard-first and dense by design: stat tiles, status badges, and card grids optimized for scanning operational state (parcel status, shipment tracking, KYC progress) rather than persuading a visitor. Warmth lives in the details — soft shadows, rounded corners, gold-on-cream badge treatments — while trust lives in the structure: consistent card chrome, a fixed teal sidebar, and status color-coding that never varies.
keyCharacteristics: Deep teal/navy base with gold as a rare, meaningful accent — not a decorative wash.
Warm, rounded geometry (8–24px radii) softens an otherwise official, procedural tone.
Dense, scannable dashboard layout: stat tiles, status badges, card grids.
Serif display type (Fraunces) for headings against a clean sans body (Manrope) — ledger authority paired with everyday legibility.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Treasure Gold marks the single most important action or state on a screen — the primary button, the active nav item, the approved badge. It never floods a layout; its rarity is what makes it read as significant.

rules.name: The Response, Not Rest Rule
rules.body: Shadows deepen only in response to hover/interaction state; resting surfaces stay close to flat.

dos: Do reserve Treasure Gold for the single most important element per screen (The One Seal Rule).
Do pair Fraunces headings with Manrope body text; don't introduce a third typeface.
Do keep shadows flat at rest and only deepen them on hover/interaction.
Do use full pill radius for status badges and pill-shaped brand elements; use 8–24px scaled radius everywhere else.
donts: Don't use Treasure Gold as a background wash or fill large surface areas with it — it reads as noise, not a seal.
Don't introduce sharp (0px radius) corners; the system has no sharp-edged precedent.
Don't invent new semantic colors outside the established success/warning/danger triad — reuse them.
